games.title: Sand Blocks: Drop Puzzle
games.description:
Pull the sand. Fill the pits. Clear the board.

Dive into a satisfying puzzle experience where colorful sand flows with real physics and every move shapes the board.

In this relaxing yet strategic puzzle game, your goal is to clear the level before time runs out. The grid is filled with colorful sand blocks and Tetris-shaped pits waiting to be filled. By pulling the correct colored sand toward the matching pits, you create smooth flows that drop, shift, and settle naturally thanks to dynamic sand physics.

Watch the sand cascade, fill the shapes perfectly, and trigger satisfying movements as the board clears.

As you progress, levels introduce more complex layouts, tighter time limits, and smarter puzzles that challenge your planning and timing.
games.summary: Pull the sand, fill the pits, clear the board in this relaxing physics puzzle!
